scope: One matched development screen; no R2/R3, no retained60 reads, no historical evidence changes
H: Unchanged baselines.postprocess: twice normalize+two_opt60 then normalize; joint_search2; normalize; export and independent scalar validation
objective: J=L+0.75K, closed route; exact positive coverage/current-to-candidate/home reachability action mask
target: Delta=(Yref-Ya)/max(Yref,1e-8), Y=J(H(prefix+action+Complete_reference)); positive preferred; model argmax all legal actions
supersedes: R1 revised design J-only Huber is superseded BEFORE DATA by user-requested normalized advantage regression+ranking. All four groups receive complete ordered prefix GRU.

architecture.common: true current/home D, exact masks, prefix edge costs, coverage, geometry
architecture.topology: geometric nearest16 excluding self plus4 quantile ranks floor((2q+1)*R/8) in remaining Euclidean-distance order; distance ties originalID; topology shared and never selected by D

groups.A: base fixed g0 with matched new states
groups.B: nav fixed g0 with matched new states

init: 32 nativeFixed3 training reference calls+508 checkpoint menus*up to8; first28 scenes16 thresholds, last4 scenes15. Duplicated crossed threshold prefixes skipped, never replace seeds/states.
query: reference first (include both group references in paired states); gain/(distance+.75) descending fill4, current distance fill6, independent permutation fill8. Numeric ties original ID. Only actually queried legal actions enter loss.

rounds.first: 4 coverage thresholds0,.25,.5,.75 from actual g0 trajectories; same pair states and labels
rounds.second: per scene 2 thresholds0,.5 from fixed g0 plus2 thresholds.25,.75 from current API reference actual trajectories; same pool and menu for fixed/API pair; no duplicate state replacement
rounds.optimizer: Adam1e-4 at warm; fresh identical Adam1e-4 at round1; retain corresponding optimizer state into round2; clip norm1; no dropout
rounds.promotion: after round1 only: API candidate vs its current g0 on ALL new dev32: mean relative gain>=.5%, paired bootstrap95 lower>0, all feasible. Otherwise keep g0. No best-checkpoint selection after endpoints.
rounds.invariant: before promotion A1=C1, B1=D1 exact parameter tensors and dev greedy raw/final routes/J; if reference not promoted also require corresponding round2 identity

loss.regression: SmoothL1 beta.02 on Delta queried actions only
loss.ranking: all queried pairs weighted by absolute true Delta gap; softplus(-signGap*predGap/.02); skip ties<=1e-8
loss.unqueried: unknown; no zero fill, no loss and no pseudo label
loss.replay: warm labels used only for warm1024; each round uses only its frozen-reference current labels, eight same-scene states; fixed/API matched scene/minibatch indices

audit: after each round on actual training state pool: evaluate learner all-menu argmax under corresponding frozen reference; if in queried8 reuse label; otherwise1 billed fullH. Never fit/promote/select using these audit outcomes. This tests action generalization on seen states, not unseen-state generalization.

validation.independence: new development maps independent of train/R0, but SAME dev32 used for promotion and final screen => exploratory, not untouched test confirmation
validation.baselines: Fixed3/Detour16 retain full native pipeline; gBH teacher uses commonH; prior/old/neural use commonH. Do not claim all native baselines have an identical pipeline.
validation.timing: random deterministic method/cache order; scene generation/JSON load excluded; deploy total=timed C/F/D preparation+feature/static encode/decision+oracle compute (H/native, export, independent scalar checks). Journal/fsync/summary IO excluded by oracle compute stopwatch; observed full request wall and bookkeeping residual separately saved. No inter-request neural embedding reuse; model load outside and reported; GPU synchronize boundaries.

gate.main: ALL32 valid; D2vsB2 mean>=.5% and paired95lower>0; D2vswarm_nav95lower>0; D2vsold128+H95lower>0
gate.strong_deployment: also Detour16 relative degradation one-sided95upper<=.5%; complete time median ratio<=.7 and p95ratio<=1 in both navcache modes; not quality/time dominated byFixed3
gate.inference: no online Complete lookahead; one greedy full-menu model construction+H; no rulefallback
gate.fail: close this configuration; no further updates/seeds/rounds; retain R0 opportunity result; R2 never automatically starts

bootstrap.CI: paired percentile95; exploratory; no multiple-comparison confirmatory claim

wall.calibration: initial labels;3 untrained raw greedy NN probes per representation;16 forward/backward probes per representation, NO optimizer updates; all tracked
wall.scope: starts immediately before first optimizer step; includes all following training, raw trajectories, oracle calls, audits, validation and timing. Initial collection/calibration separately recorded. Deadline checked between calls/steps, cannot extend.
wall.incomplete: inconclusive_stop; preserve failed calls/checkpoints; no replacement run or early-checkpoint substitution

counters: actual terminal native/H calls vs label uses/cachehits; internal solver calls, NN staticencodes/score batches/rows, raw trajectories/decisions, backward probes and actual/logical optimizer steps separately; topcalls are not equal FLOPs
